why: EventKit has no callback or async API for calendar changes: EKEventStoreChanged is the only signal. SystemCalendarChanges observes it once per app (made at the composition root, AppsService) and only bumps a revision that AppProviderChangeFeed.systemCalendar turns into one coalesced apps-provider-changed for system_calendar, so cmux.watch("system_calendar.events") re-reads on a change instead of every calendar widget polling on a timer.
